howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Matrix 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/、追加注册导入、安装固定版本的适配器包、给 matrix-js-sdk 打 ESM 补丁,再跑构建与注册测试;之后引导你填写 homeserver 地址和独立机器人账号凭据并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加 Matrix 频道时触发。凭据部分由你手动完成:需在 Element 里为机器人另注册一个账号,因为 Matrix 不能给自己发私信。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, adds the registration import, installs the pinned adapter package, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, builds and tests. Also writes homeserver and bot credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Matrix channel to NanoClaw. The credential steps are manual: you register a separate bot account in Element, since Matrix can't DM your own account.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, builds

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with an access token
say_en.note: Uses Option B and sets MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN

say_en.text: Build fails on matrix-js-sdk/lib — re-run the patch
say_en.note: Re-runs step 4, the idempotent ESM patch
